diff --git a/crates/desktop-core/Cargo.toml b/crates/desktop-core/Cargo.toml
index bfc65be5..13ef2911 100644
--- a/crates/desktop-core/Cargo.toml
+++ b/crates/desktop-core/Cargo.toml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 [package]
 name = "desktop-core"
-version = "0.2.0"
+version = "2.0.0"
 description = "Prisma AIRS Desktop v2 application core: native authority, context and outcomes"
 edition.workspace = true
 rust-version.workspace = true
diff --git a/crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs b/crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs
index 0f043742..f8d1c1e7 100644
--- a/crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs
+++ b/crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs
@@ -876,7 +876,23 @@ async fn execute(inner: &Arc<Inner>, request: WorkbenchRequest) -> WorkbenchResu
     match request {
         WorkbenchRequest::Load => WorkbenchResult::Done,
         WorkbenchRequest::OpenFolder => match inner.adapters.folders.choose_folder().await {
-            Some(folder) => open_at(inner, &root, folder, false).await,
+            Some(folder) => {
+                // D057: an empty folder becomes a new collection in place;
+                // any other folder without collection.toml stays refused.
+                let target = folder.clone();
+                let ready = blocking(Err(ProjectProblem::Io), move || {
+                    if project::empty_folder(&target) {
+                        project::create_collection(&target).map(|_| ())
+                    } else {
+                        Ok(())
+                    }
+                })
+                .await;
+                match ready {
+                    Ok(()) => open_at(inner, &root, folder, false).await,
+                    Err(p) => refused(WorkbenchProblem::Project(p)),
+                }
+            }
             None => WorkbenchResult::Cancelled,
         },
         WorkbenchRequest::CreateCollection => match inner.adapters.folders.choose_new().await {
diff --git a/tools/native-acceptance/fixture_app.py b/tools/native-acceptance/fixture_app.py
index 9b089ada..dcc6fe10 100644
--- a/tools/native-acceptance/fixture_app.py
+++ b/tools/native-acceptance/fixture_app.py
@@ -222,9 +222,16 @@ class App:
 
     # ---- flows ----
     def open_settings(self):
-        self.keys(",", "command down")
-        tree, _ = self.wait_for(lambda t: self.node(t, "AXHeading", "Settings") is not None)
-        return tree
+        """Opens Settings and waits until its form is in the tree (the heading
+        lands before the fields under load; a second ⌘, is sent if the sheet
+        did not open)."""
+        ready = lambda t: self.node(t, "AXHeading", "Settings") is not None and self.node(t, "AXTextField", "TSG ID (optional)") is not None
+        for _ in range(2):
+            self.keys(",", "command down")
+            tree, ok = self.wait_for(ready, 20)
+            if ok:
+                return tree
+        raise RuntimeError("Settings did not open with its tenant form")
 
     def open_runtime(self):
         self.ax("press", "AXButton", "Runtime Security")
